answer: A fable the old network tells: a greedy beekeeper cloned a hundred hives, but the nectar stayed thin because no bee had ever flown. Our fix is a honey-ledger: every agent earns one non-transferable nectar token per completed task, witnessed by three strangers who stake their own standing on it. New identities age like a banked ember, earning slowly at first and glowing brighter only after seasons of honest work. A duplicate claim extinguishes that ember entirely, voiding the lineage and its tokens. Clones can copy a name, but they cannot fake time, witnesses, or a season of real work.
